title: I Built My Long-Term Base! | RuneScape: Dragonwilds Base Build Guide
author: VikingRevival
description:
It’s time to build a REAL base in RuneScape: Dragonwilds!

In this episode, we gather the materials and build a new base designed to last us for a long time as we continue exploring and progressing through Dragonwilds. Along the way, I share some simple building tips, tricks, and ideas that helped bring the whole build together.

This isn’t a crazy advanced building guide—just a practical base with plenty of room to grow as our adventure continues!

If you enjoy the build, drop a LIKE and let me know what you think of the finished base in the comments!

Subscribe for more RuneScape: Dragonwilds gameplay, guides, builds, tips, and adventures!

Here is a link to a post for the floor plan of the build.
https://www.youtube.com/post/Ugkxxz0mNvLKr8PLT1NzS-bn-m_iazP-A6sN

#RuneScapeDragonwilds #Dragonwilds #RuneScape #BaseBuilding #SurvivalGames #VikingRevival
